pairing: Each sourcecase uses the same environment/planner seed across native, fixed_ap and initial_retrieval, interleaved in that fixed arm order. Candidate clipping, search caps, safety head, margins and FP32 preprocessing are identical within each protocol.

controller_static_parameters.origin: Literal copies of helper.fixed_ap_parameters and helper.initial_parameters; no local model/numerical experiment code executed to produce protocols.

information: Native always plans to original observedgoal. Fixed/initial retrieval select originalgoal or actual frozen-memory observedsuccessor; no interpolation or exactlive finalgoalXY in controller. All comparators receive the same fixedmemory, nativebodyXY, hazardgeometry and originalgoalRGB. The originalphysicalgoal<16px remains the only task-success rule.
comparison_limits: SMALL versus LARGE is a separately frozen online-budget diagnostic; do not claim budget-matched superiority across those recipes. Inside each recipe caps are matched, actualwork/earlytermination retained. An AP/initial gain is not an evolutionary result. Bad untrained performance is not a veto on iterative evolutionary development under the active seven-hour authorization.
accounting: Count all24episode starts/resets and every native action including failures. Persist actual encoder/predictor batch attempts, candidate blocksteps, learnedmotion work, elapsedtime and retrieval-queryfeature hashes; preserve proposed versus executed nativecommands. Common memory preparation costs remain in separate campaign ledger, not hidden or repeated percomparator.
stopping: No silent replay or case substitution. Technical/input-quality failure retained for root-cause diagnosis under a new source/protocol/output namespace. No additional episode starts inside15-minute global preservation reserve. Sealed final5000..5255 and development-selection2000..2127 receive no controller intervention in these pilots.
